entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Containers integration tests are flaky when the network fails to load the registry #49502
  • Update `--cli-schema` output for consistency #49500
  • The new RID-specific tools should support a fallback for framework dependent, RID-agnostic tools #49499
  • Support launching .NET apps (source and compiled) using dnx #49495
  • multi-RID tools that are framework-dependent do not work #49494
    10.0.1xx

    10.0.1xx
  • `dotnet tool exec` doesn't seem to respect global package settings in nuget.config #49491
    10.0.1xx

    Backlog

    Backlog
